stories.headline: Anthropic launches Anthropic Institute, internal think tank led by co-founder Jack Clark

key_facts.fact: Anthropic announced the Anthropic Institute on March 11, an internal think tank merging three existing teams — the Frontier Red Team, Societal Impacts group, and Economic Research division — under co-founder Jack Clark, who takes the new title of Head of Public Benefit.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic has launched the 'Anthropic Institute,' an internal think tank dedicated to studying how powerful AI affects society, the economy, and security. The institute will be led by co-founder Jack Clark, who is taking on a new role as 'Head of Public Benefit.'

key_facts.fact: The institute starts with approximately 30 people and will research how AI transforms jobs, what new risks emerge from misuse, what 'values' AI systems express, and how humans can maintain control over self-improving AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: The team consists of around 30 people drawn from three existing research groups. The institute plans to research how AI is transforming jobs, what new risks emerge from misuse, what 'values' AI systems express, and how humans can maintain control over self-improving AI systems.

key_facts.fact: Key hires include Matt Botvinick (formerly Google DeepMind/Yale Law) leading AI and rule-of-law research, Anton Korinek (University of Virginia) studying economic restructuring, and Zoë Hitzig (formerly OpenAI) connecting economic research with model training.
key_facts.excerpt: Matt Botvinick (Google DeepMind/Yale Law) – leads AI and rule-of-law research. Anton Korinek (UVA economics) – studies economic restructuring. Zoë Hitzig (formerly OpenAI) – connects economic research with model training.

key_facts.fact: The launch comes days after Anthropic sued the Trump administration over a supply-chain risk designation barring Pentagon contractors from using its models. Clark stated: 'What we're experiencing...shows how much hunger there is for a larger national conversation.'
key_facts.excerpt: The announcement occurred days after Anthropic sued the Trump administration over a supply-chain risk designation. Clark stated: 'What we're experiencing...shows how much hunger there is for a larger national conversation.'

key_facts.fact: Sarah Heck, formerly Head of External Affairs, takes over the public policy team Clark built and tripled in size during 2025. Anthropic is also opening a Washington D.C. office in spring.
key_facts.excerpt: Sarah Heck takes over public policy role (formerly Head of External Affairs). Anthropic is opening a Washington D.C. office in spring.

stories.headline: Nvidia invests $2B in Nebius to build 5GW+ of AI data center capacity by 2030

key_facts.fact: Nvidia announced a $2 billion investment in Nebius Group NV as part of a strategic partnership to develop and deploy next-generation hyperscale AI cloud infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA will invest $2 billion in Nebius, reflecting NVIDIA's confidence in Nebius's business and unique depth of engineering expertise across the full AI technology stack.

key_facts.fact: The partnership targets Nebius deploying more than 5 gigawatts of Nvidia systems by end of 2030, with collaboration spanning AI factory architecture, inference and agentic AI stack development, and fleet management.
key_facts.excerpt: Deep Engineering Collaboration on AI Factories, Powering Inference and Agentic AI, Enables Nebius to Deploy More Than 5 Gigawatts of NVIDIA Systems by End of 2030.

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang said: 'Agentic AI is driving incredible compute demand and accelerating infrastructure buildout. Nebius is building an AI cloud designed for the agentic era, fully integrated from silicon to software.'
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang, NVIDIA CEO: 'Agentic AI is driving incredible compute demand and accelerating infrastructure buildout. Nebius is building an AI cloud designed for the agentic era, fully integrated from silicon to software.'

key_facts.fact: US-listed shares of Amsterdam-based Nebius jumped nearly 10% in premarket trading following the announcement. The company had recently secured approval for its first gigawatt-scale AI factory in Independence, Missouri.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S.-listed shares of Amsterdam-based Nebius jumped nearly 10% in premarket trading.

key_facts.fact: Nebius CEO Arkady Volozh stated: 'Nebius was built for AI from day one—not adapted from general-purpose cloud, but designed for what developers actually need.'
key_facts.excerpt: Arkady Volozh, Nebius CEO: 'Nebius was built for AI from day one—not adapted from general-purpose cloud, but designed for what developers actually need. With NVIDIA, we extend this throughout the stack.'

stories.headline: Meta unveils four new homegrown AI chips: MTIA 300, 400, 450, and 500

key_facts.fact: Meta announced plans to deploy four new generations of its in-house AI chips — MTIA 300, 400, 450, and 500 — by end of 2027, as part of an effort to diversify hardware sources and reduce reliance on outside chipmakers.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta Platforms Inc. plans to deploy four new generations of its in-house artificial intelligence chips by the end of 2027 as the company turns to custom silicon to help power its rapidly expanding AI workloads.

key_facts.fact: The MTIA 300 is already in production for ranking and recommendation training. The MTIA 400 delivers 400% higher FP8 FLOPS and 51% higher HBM bandwidth than the 300, with lab testing complete.
key_facts.excerpt: MTIA 300 is in production for R&R training. MTIA 400 delivers 400% higher FP8 FLOPS than MTIA 300; 51% higher HBM bandwidth.

key_facts.fact: The MTIA 450, scheduled for early 2027, doubles HBM bandwidth from the 400 and delivers 75% higher MX4 FLOPS with custom low-precision data types. The MTIA 500 uses a 2x2 compute chiplet design with 50% higher HBM bandwidth and 43% higher MX4 FLOPS than the 450.
key_facts.excerpt: MTIA 450: Doubled HBM bandwidth from MTIA 400; 75% higher MX4 FLOPS; custom low-precision data types. MTIA 500: 50% higher HBM bandwidth than MTIA 450; up to 80% higher capacity; 43% higher MX4 FLOPS. 2x2 compute chiplet configuration.

key_facts.fact: From MTIA 300 to MTIA 500, HBM bandwidth grows 4.5x and compute FLOPS grows 25x. Meta emphasizes a roughly six-month cadence per chip generation, with inference-first optimization and PyTorch-native software integration.
key_facts.excerpt: HBM bandwidth increase: 4.5x. Compute FLOPS increase: 25x. High-velocity iterative development (~six months per generation), inference-first optimization, and PyTorch-native software integration.

sources.title: Four MTIA Chips in Two Years: Scaling AI Experiences for Billions
Meta Preparing to Deploy Four New Homegrown Chips to Handle AI

stories.headline: Google releases Gemini Embedding 2, its first natively multimodal embedding model

key_facts.fact: Google released Gemini Embedding 2 in public preview on March 10, its first fully multimodal embedding model that maps text, images, video, audio, and documents into a single unified embedding space.
key_facts.excerpt: Gemini Embedding 2 is our first natively multimodal embedding model that maps text, images, video, audio and documents into a single embedding space, enabling multimodal retrieval and classification across different types of media.

key_facts.fact: The model succeeds the text-only gemini-embedding-001 and is available via the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, supporting over 100 languages and enabling cross-modal retrieval for RAG, semantic search, and classification.
key_facts.excerpt: Expanding on our previous text-only foundation, Gemini Embedding 2 maps text, images, videos, audio and documents into a single, unified embedding space, and captures semantic intent across over 100 languages.

key_facts.fact: VentureBeat reported the model reduces latency by as much as 70% for some enterprise customers and lowers total cost for enterprises using RAG-powered AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Reducing latency by as much as 70% for some customers and reducing total cost for enterprises who use AI models powered by their own data to complete business tasks.

sources.title: Gemini Embedding 2: Our first natively multimodal embedding model
Google's Gemini Embedding 2 arrives with native multimodal support to cut costs and speed up your enterprise data stack

stories.headline: OpenAI adds interactive visual learning tools for math and science to ChatGPT

key_facts.fact: OpenAI launched dynamic visual explanations in ChatGPT on March 10, allowing users to manipulate mathematical and scientific formulas in real time with adjustable sliders, covering 70+ core math and science concepts.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're making learning these concepts in ChatGPT even more interactive with new dynamic visual explanations. Starting with more than 70 core math and science concepts, ChatGPT will guide learners by showing how formulas, variables, and relationships behave in real time.

key_facts.fact: Each week 140 million people use ChatGPT for math and science learning. The feature covers topics from the Pythagorean theorem to Ohm's law to compound interest.
key_facts.excerpt: Each week, 140 million people use ChatGPT to help them understand math and science concepts alone.

key_facts.fact: The new experience is available globally to all logged-in ChatGPT users. Instead of just text responses, ChatGPT now generates dynamic modules where users can adjust variables and see visual changes in real time.
key_facts.excerpt: Instead of just reading an explanation or looking at a static diagram, users can now engage directly with interactive visuals.

stories.headline: Databricks launches Genie Code, autonomous AI agent that doubles success rate on data tasks

key_facts.fact: Databricks launched Genie Code on March 11, an autonomous AI agent for data work that can build ML pipelines, debug failures, ship dashboards, and maintain production systems with enterprise governance via Unity Catalog.
key_facts.excerpt: Genie Code can carry out complex tasks such as building pipelines, debugging failures, shipping dashboards, and maintaining production systems.

key_facts.fact: On real-world data science tasks, Databricks found Genie Code more than doubled the success rate of leading coding agents, improving from 32.1% to 77.1%.
key_facts.excerpt: On real-world data science tasks, Databricks found Genie Code more than doubled the success rate of leading coding agents.

key_facts.fact: CEO Ali Ghodsi called the paradigm 'Agentic Data Work,' likening it to how agentic coding tools transformed software engineering. The agent improves through persistent memory and learning from interactions.
key_facts.excerpt: Ali Ghodsi, CEO: 'Genie Code brings this revolution to data teams...we are calling this Agentic Data Work.'

key_facts.fact: Databricks also announced acquiring Quotient AI to embed continuous evaluation and reinforcement learning into Genie Code.
key_facts.excerpt: Databricks also announced acquiring Quotient AI to embed continuous evaluation and reinforcement learning into Genie Code.

sources.title: Databricks Launches Genie Code: Bringing Agentic Engineering to Data Work

stories.headline: DeepMind marks AlphaGo's 10th anniversary as Hassabis lays out path to AGI

key_facts.fact: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis published a blog post on March 10 marking the 10th anniversary of AlphaGo's victory over world champion Lee Sedol, calling it the beginning of the modern AI era.
key_facts.excerpt: Ten years ago, our AI system AlphaGo became the first program to defeat a world champion at the complex game of Go – reaching a milestone in the field a decade before many experts thought possible.

key_facts.fact: Hassabis made DeepMind's AGI strategy explicit: combine Gemini's multimodal world models, AlphaGo's search and planning techniques, and specialized AI tools like AlphaFold into a unified system.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, this breakthrough continues to inform our work building systems on the path to artificial general intelligence (AGI). We believe AGI will be the most profound technology ever invented and potentially the ultimate tool to advance science, medicine, and productivity.

key_facts.fact: Hassabis reiterated DeepMind's AGI timeline estimate of around 2030, stating they are 'on a trajectory toward AGI around 2030' with a 50% probability within five years, requiring 'two or three big innovations' in multimodal models, reasoning, memory, and planning.
key_facts.excerpt: We are on a trajectory toward AGI around 2030.

sources.title: AlphaGo at 10: How AI Innovation Is Paving the Path to AGI
DeepMind Marks 10 Years Since AlphaGo Changed AI Forever

stories.headline: Unreasonable Labs raises $13.5M from stealth to build AI engine for cross-disciplinary scientific discovery

key_facts.fact: Unreasonable Labs emerged from stealth on March 10 with a $13.5 million funding round led by Playground Global, with participation from AIX Ventures, E14 Fund, and MS&AD Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: Unreasonable Labs, the company building superintelligence for knowledge discovery, today announced it has launched from stealth and closed a $13.5 million funding round led by Playground Global, with participation from AIX Ventures, E14 Fund, and MS&AD Ventures.

key_facts.fact: Founded by Yuan Cao (former senior research scientist at Google DeepMind) and Markus Buehler (MIT engineering professor), the company pairs LLMs with neurosymbolic mathematical abstractions to generate novel scientific hypotheses across chemistry, materials science, and biology.
key_facts.excerpt: The company, founded by a former senior research scientist at Google DeepMind and an engineering professor at MIT, has built a foundational AI discovery engine designed to accelerate breakthroughs by composing new knowledge across chemistry, materials science, biology, and beyond.

key_facts.fact: Unlike most AI-for-science tools narrowly trained on specific datasets like protein folding or battery chemistry, Unreasonable claims to have built a general framework that incentivizes models to reason beyond their intrinsic world representations using a map of relationships.
key_facts.excerpt: While most AI for science tools are narrowly trained on specific datasets—such as protein folding or battery chemistry—Unreasonable has built a general framework that incentivizes models to reason beyond their intrinsic world representations.

sources.title: Unreasonable Labs Raises $13.5M Funding Round to Scale Superintelligence for Knowledge Discovery
